item_short_desc: Rothco's Plastic Waterproof Match Box is designed to keep your matches secure and protected from the elements, making it an essential item for outdoor enthusiasts and emergency preparedness. The water-tight screw top ensures that your matches stay dry, even in wet conditions. The match box also features a convenient striking strip at the bottom for easy lighting. Compact and durable, this waterproof match box is perfect for camping trips, hiking adventures, or building the perfect bug out bag.
